introduction.problem_before: Every RPC call built from RpcConfig::default() waits up to 30 s; the wallet UI froze for 30 s on an unreachable peer (issue #470).
introduction.change: Every attempt now waits at most 5 s.
introduction.example_before_after: Before: timeout = Duration::from_secs(30). After: timeout = Duration::from_secs(5), for each of up to 3 attempts.

steps.title: Default timeout 30 s → 5 s
steps.why: The wallet UI froze for 30 s on an unreachable peer (issue #470).

annotations.is: timeout = 5 s, for each of up to 3 attempts.

annotations.text: sync::fetch_headers relied on the longer wait; CI: sync_headers::slow_peer_2000_headers fails with a timeout after 5 s.
Potential header sync timeout on slow peers:

scenario: A node syncs from a slow peer and requests 2000 headers.
The reply takes 10 to 20 s, as the comment beside the setting says.
The new 5 s timeout ends each attempt first, and every retry ends the same way.
Header sync stalls; the failing CI test is about this path.
flag.not_checked: The CI test was not run here; peer timings were not measured.

assessment.headline: Header sync from slow peers may fail where it used to finish; an operator would see sync stall on slow links.
assessment.reason: Affects node sync on slow links, not wallet funds; CI already shows a failing test for it.
assessment.basis_note: Read: 3 files (config.rs, sync/mod.rs, the CI log)
assessment.smallest_correction: Keep a longer timeout for get_headers or pass a per-request timeout in fetch_headers.

steps.title: Affected code: sync::fetch_headers
steps.decides: Requests up to 2000 headers in one reply.
steps.why: Shown because the default timeout reaches it, although the file is not in the diff.

annotations.text: A reply that needs 10-20 s now times out on every attempt.
Same risk as the red flag on step 1: a 2000-header reply from a slow peer may take longer than 5 s.

assessment.reason: This caller requests a large batch; the timeout change that reaches it is assessed in the preceding step.

impact_refs.reason: The failing CI test: its peer answers after 12 s, longer than the new 5 s timeout.
